outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Minutes - Board of Education - Regular Meeting - August 26, 2026

enrichment.headline: Pays Soccer Without Borders up to $48,300 for soccer and wellness support at Rudsdale
enrichment.summary: Soccer Without Borders will serve 60 students at Rudsdale Continuation High School with weekly practices, coaching, mentorship and league play, and will cover uniforms, equipment, league fees and transportation support. The agreement runs August 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027 and began before this board vote.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Soccer Without Borders - Rudsdale Continuation High School
